messages:
maria: FYI customer hitting 400s on /call-tool after last-night rename. They keep sending handle `ImageGen_v2` but registry shows `image-gen`. Error from our API: \"tool not found\".

alex: Can you paste the exact curl and the error body? Also need request-id for the customer.

maria: curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/call \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \n  -d '{\"tool\":\"ImageGen_v2\",\"args\":{...}}'
```
Response body: `{\"error\":\"ToolLookupError: handle not found\", \"code\":404}`. Request id: req_0ab3e6.

sam: Does the client SDK do any case-normalization? Could be a casing mismatch / alias TTL issue. Is the old alias still present in the registry?

maria: I checked: registry UI shows only `image-gen` (lowercase). We do have an alias mapping record in backfill table for `ImageGen_v2` but its `active` flag is false. Looks like a rename + alias-deactivate during rollout. Customer traffic still uses old name.

jen-oncall: @alex @sam this should have a graceful fallback: lookup exact, then casefold, then alias table. If alias was deactivated too early the client will 404. Can we confirm the rollout backfill job ran? :thinking:

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline finished for service registry-sync (rev a1f9c3) at 2024-11-09T03:12:14Z.

alex: repro idea: try both handles in a quick request from support laptop. If `image-gen` succeeds and `ImageGen_v2` 404s, it's alias deactivation. Quick curl to test both.
maria: repro from my laptop: `image-gen` -> 200, response contains `tool_id: tg_9x2`. `ImageGen_v2` -> 404. Intermittent: one customer reported success after retrying (maybe cached alias on our edge).

sam: sounds like a sync-window bug. The registry-sync job changed canonical name to lowercase and deactivated the alias, but edge caches weren't invalidated. Need to check cache TTL and global invalidate. Which job ran last? commit a1f9c3 (deploy bot) looks like the registry change.
alex: Can support collect the failing request payloads + request ids (we have req_0ab3e6). I'll open eng-runtime ticket and include these logs + commit. Also confirm whether the alias record exists in `aliases` table with `deactivated_at`. If deactivated within the last 24h we should consider rollback/fail-open for customer-critical calls.
maria: I'll collect more req ids from the customer and paste here. For now capturing these two: req_0ab3e6, req_0ab3f2. Escalating to eng-runtime with tag `priority:high` and linking this thread.

alex: Thanks — if we need to run a manual alias reactivation we can do a targeted patch to alias row. But eng needs to confirm safety.

jen-oncall: Also add note to incident: edge cache invalidation didn't propagate for alias-deactivate events. If confirmed, we should add an immediate cache purge in the pipeline.

maria: will attach the customer repro steps and request dump to the ticket. :raised_hands:
